snippet.title: The Last Nordic Tribe TRAILER
snippet.description:
We’re happy to announce that the game will premiere on May 7 on Steam at 8:00 PM (Warsaw time)!

🇵🇱 Warsaw: 8:00 PM (CEST)

🇨🇦 Toronto: 2:00 PM (EDT)

🇺🇸 New York: 2:00 PM (EDT)

🇺🇸 Los Angeles: 11:00 AM (PDT)

🇦🇺 Sydney: 4:00 AM (AEST, May 8)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3435710/The_Last_Nordic_Tribe
